name: Olvera (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of light blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Olvera (a castle on yellow with the motto SALE DE MI LA PAZ).
history: The local flag, created in 1999, was entered in the Andalusian catalogue of symbols of local entities in 2004 with the description of a rectangular oblong flag of proportion 11 by 18, composed of three vertical stripes of equal width parallel to the staff, which is to be of wood painted white.

features.role: Olvera arms — castle on yellow with motto
